style: instrumental, no vocals. Jump-up drum and bass at 174 BPM, cartoon-loud and gleeful. Scene: a rave bursts open in a strip-lit council basement and the party is already flat out on the first downbeat, no lead-in at all. The star is a rubbery, honking midrange hoover bass, filter wobbling under a fast LFO, lurching and stamping around like a toddler mid-tantrum, then barking back at itself in goofy pitch-bent yelps on a simple two-note riff. Under it, stripped-back drums: a punchy kick, a fat dry snare that cracks hard on every 2 and 4, open and closed hats flicking between them. Cheeky slapstick vandalism, the sound of confetti made of paperwork. One 8-bar bass riff repeated end to end so it loops cleanly, loud club master, deep sub
exclude: vocals, singing, MC, rap, hype shouts, vocal chops, chants, crowd noise, spoken word, humming, choir, intro, ambient pad, slow build, breakdown, riser, piano, liquid, soft
lyrics:
[Drop: slam straight in, bass and drums together]
[Instrumental]
[Same 8-bar wobble riff, again and again, no breakdown]
[Hard stop]
title: The Rules drop r1-jump-up-cartoon-wobble
